calls.video_title: The AI Stock Sell-Off: 4 Stocks Wall Street Is Getting Wrong?
calls.thesis: First tracked call. Record fiscal year: Q4 revenue ~$115bn (+12%), iPhone ~$58bn (+17%), services a record ~$32bn. Couch calls it the most predictable, boring Mag 7 name: it does not need to win at AI, and its cash pile lets it buy AI companies later if needed.
calls.base_case: iPhone 17 demand and services growth keep compounding; AI tailwinds arrive second-order via App Store fees on external AI apps (~$1bn+/yr).
calls.bull_case: In a downturn Apple uses its cash to scoop up AI assets and re-enters the race cheaply.
calls.bear_case: Rising memory costs and the rebuilt Siri rollout squeeze holiday-quarter margins; iPad, wearables and Greater China stay soft.
calls.collab_byline: The Motley Fool and Couch Investor

calls.video_title: Is Apple Stock a Buy After Earnings? | AAPL Stock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: DCF fair value $204 vs market $338 going into results; forward PE over 34
calls.thesis: HOLD reiterated (was HOLD 12 Oct, FV $195 vs $336) — not a buying opportunity after the post-earnings dip: excellent quarter but still overvalued; wait for a better price to enter.
calls.base_case: Strong fundamentals continue: iPhone sales $57.6B (vs $49B), China sales $17.5B (vs $14.5B), operating income +$3.2B YoY to ~$35.66B (+~10%).
calls.bull_case: iPhone Duo sold out, delivery wait to mid-January; cycle sales may beat 10M-unit estimates at a higher average selling price.
calls.bear_case: Valuation rich after +20% YTD: forward PE over 34 and DCF $204 vs $338; soaring memory/storage costs (triple-digit rises since the AI boom) pressure device margins.

calls.thesis: Reiterated Oct 9: iPhone 18 Pro demand reportedly slowing on $100 price hikes (Nikkei Asia: Oct orders cut 15-20%); pricing power stretched at 31x forward P/E; FV $195 vs $336 market — not a buying opportunity.
calls.bull_case: iPhone Duo foldable (10/23 launch) could top his 20M-unit estimate vs 10M consensus
calls.bear_case: Consumers stretched by housing/food/insurance costs; further demand cuts on premium phones

calls.price_at_call: ~$342 (avg analyst PT $342 = current price; 36.7x forward PE)
calls.thesis: Loves the business, NOT buying: 36.7x forward PE for single-digit earnings growth is 'way too expensive'; waiting for a better entry if volatility gives him his price.
calls.base_case: Base: services/AI drive modest growth; fairly valued at best.
calls.bull_case: Bull: AI upgrade cycle + margin expansion justifies premium on a pullback.
calls.bear_case: Bear: multiple compression if growth stays single-digit; 10Y >5% raises required return.
